title: Sanger Tree of Life HMW DNA Fragmentation Using Diagenode Megaruptor®3
author: Adam Bates

steps.title: Prepare and Label Tubes
steps.instruction: Label the required number of Diagenode Hydro Tubes for each DNA sample on both the lid and the side.

steps.title: Prepare DNA Samples
steps.instruction: Mix the DNA sample by pipetting carefully with a wide-bore pipette tip before transferring it from the original tube.

steps.title: Transfer and Normalize DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the DNA samples to the labeled Diagenode Hydro Tubes, ensuring specific volume and concentration requirements are met.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 100–130 µL of DNA per tube.
Ensure concentration is between 3 ng/µL and 39 ng/µL (ideally 30 ng/µL).
Normalize all tubes to an equal volume using EB buffer or nuclease-free water.

steps.title: Seal and Centrifuge Tubes
steps.instruction: Replace the Hydro Tube lids and briefly centrifuge the tubes using a mini-centrifuge.

steps.title: Prepare Hydropore-Syringes
steps.instruction: Inspect the Hydropore-Syringes to ensure they are correctly assembled.

substeps.instruction: Check that each syringe is screwed together.
Ensure all joints/screw tops are tight.
Verify the plunger is pushed all the way down.

steps.title: Attach Syringes to Tubes
steps.instruction: Remove the Hydro Tube lids and firmly push a Hydropore-Syringe onto the top of the tube (do not screw it on). Retain the tube lid.

steps.title: Initialize Megaruptor 3
steps.instruction: Switch on the Diagenode Megaruptor®3 and initialize it following the on-screen instructions.

substeps.instruction: Remove the loading cassette by lifting it up and away from the base unit.
Wait approximately 3 seconds for the arms to set to the 'zero' position.
Replace the cassette on the base unit.

steps.title: Configure Run Parameters
steps.instruction: Use the touch screen to set up the run by selecting 'Protocols' and then 'Go & Shear' with the following parameters:

substeps.instruction: Concentration: Select the highest concentration in the sample set (Note: samples in one run should not vary by more than ± 25 ng/µL; samples < 50 ng/µL should not be combined with those > 50 ng/µL; do not use for samples > 150 ng/µL without dilution).
Volume: As measured.
Speed: 31.

steps.title: Load Samples into Cassette
steps.instruction: Load the Hydropore-Syringes into the cassette when prompted by the touch screen.

substeps.instruction: Balance the load symmetrically across the 8 positions, using empty balance Hydropore-Syringes for uneven sample numbers.
Orient the Hydropore-Syringe so the clear side faces out to observe DNA solution movement.

steps.title: Execute and Monitor Shearing
steps.instruction: Start the program and visually confirm that all syringes are drawing up liquid.

substeps.instruction: Verify liquid movement once the 'shearing' step is reached.
Note that the run takes approximately 45 minutes (the on-screen countdown may be inaccurate).

steps.title: Recover Sheared DNA
steps.instruction: Remove the Hydropore-Syringes from the instrument and the Hydro Tubes.

substeps.instruction: Press down on the plunger during removal from the Hydro Tube to collect residual liquid/sample within the hydropore.

steps.title: Finalize and Store
steps.instruction: Clean up and store the processed samples.

substeps.instruction: Discard Hydropore-Syringes as biological waste.
Replace the retained lids onto the Hydro Tubes.
Store the sheared DNA at 4 °C.
